entities.title: The hook classifies words, it does not parse the shell
entities.summary: HookPolicy splits a command at |, ;, &, parentheses, backquotes and newlines and looks at the first program of each segment after wrappers such as env, sudo and xargs.
entities.impact: A search or read hidden inside another program's arguments (for example sh -c "grep ...") is not blocked; the hook steers agents, it does not enforce.

entities.title: init writes this machine's binary path
entities.summary: The server command in .mcp.json and the hook command in .claude/settings.json are the absolute path of the csharp-indexer that ran init, and the zazzle server command is the absolute path of the daemon it found.
entities.impact: If those files are shared, other machines need both binaries at the same paths or must run init themselves; moving either binary breaks its server (and, for the indexer, the hook) until init runs again.

entities.title: init does not clean up entries from the tool's former name
entities.summary: init replaces only hook entries whose command contains csharp-indexer, and adds its own server, permission and enabled-server names; entries written when the tool was called codeindexd stay.
entities.impact: In a project initialised before the rename, running init again leaves the old codeindexd server in .mcp.json and the old hook, permission and enabled server in .claude/settings.json beside the new ones, so the old hook keeps running before the tool calls it was configured for, for as long as its binary exists.
entities.workaround: Remove the codeindexd entries from both files by hand.
entities.details: A deliberate historical note: codeindexd was this tool's name before the rename to csharp-indexer.

entities.title: uninit does not restore what init removed
entities.summary: init removes the indexer's own csharp-indexer server, its mcp__zazzle-csharp-indexer permission and enabled server from an earlier init; uninit takes out zazzle's entries and the hook but does not put those back.
entities.impact: A project initialised by an old version and then uninitialised has neither server; the indexer's own server lists no tools, so nothing an agent used is lost.

entities.title: uninit cannot tell who created a file
entities.summary: uninit deletes .mcp.json or .claude/settings.json when its removals leave nothing but empty objects and arrays, without knowing whether init or the developer created the file.
entities.impact: A file the developer created before init that held only init's entries and empty containers is deleted rather than left as {}; Claude Code treats a missing file and an empty one alike.
